meta.output: model score (not a calibrated probability; trained on negatives undersampled 20:1)
meta.operating_cut_method: TSS-optimal on year-grouped inner out-of-fold calibration predictions
meta.cut5_method: 95th percentile of inner out-of-fold calibration scores
meta.source_paper: Tiwari K et al., National landslide susceptibility and rainfall-triggering thresholds in India
limitations: Daily 0.25 degree rainfall misses sub-daily bursts
Evaluation dominated by 2013-2016 NASA GLC events
Scores for 2007-2012 are in-sample for the final model
